title: Graubündener Straße, Bremen
description:
Welcome to this tastefully decorated two-room apartment, offering approximately 57 m2 of living space. The property is equipped with modern amenities, bright rooms and a tranquil location.
The apartment is situated in a well-maintained apartment building that includes an elevator, making it ideal for business travellers, project staff, or couples who wish to reside in Bremen for a limited time.

The living room is open plan, welcoming and furnished to an exacting standard – with a comfortable sofa, smart TV, dining table and large windows that allow in plenty of natural light. The living room opens directly onto the balcony, which is furnished with seating and offers a pleasant view of the green surroundings.

The property is equipped with a fully-fitted kitchen that is fully equipped with modern appliances, including an oven, induction hob, refrigerator with freezer compartment, dishwasher, coffee machine, kettle, toaster, and all the necessary cooking and dining utensils.

The bedroom is equipped with a comfortable double bed, fresh bedding, a large wardrobe, and stylish décor.
The modern bathroom is equipped with a shower and a washing machine.

All utilities are included in the rental agreement, so there is no need for additional expenditure.

title: Graubündener Straße, Bremen
description:

The modern built-in kitchen is fully equipped and provides everything you need for your daily cooking routine:
oven, induction hob, refrigerator with freezer, dishwasher, coffee machine, toaster, kettle, and a complete set of cookware and tableware.

In the bedroom, you will find a comfortable double bed, a spacious wardrobe, and stylish decor.
The separate office room offers a bright workspace with a desk, shelves, and ample storage – perfect for home office or focused work.

The modern bathroom is equipped with a walk-in shower.

All utilities are included in the rent – just move in and feel at home.

title: Mühlenweg, Bremen
description:
Exclusive Fully Furnished 2-Room Apartment for Temporary Living
Prime Location in Bremen-Oberneuland

First Occupancy 2026 · Smart Home · High-End Features · Excellent Connectivity

Located in one of Bremen’s most desirable residential areas – the prestigious villa district of Oberneuland – this high-quality, fully renovated and fully furnished 2-room garden apartment offers approximately 60 m2 of living space on the ground floor.
The neighborhood is characterized by elegant single-family homes, mature trees, lakes, and park landscapes. You will enjoy peaceful, green, and private living, while benefiting from excellent connections to Bremen’s city center, technology park, and key business locations.

Premium Temporary Living
The apartment will be occupied for the first time in 2026 after a complete renovation. All furnishings and fittings are new and carefully selected with one goal in mind:
Move in, unpack your personal belongings – and feel at home immediately.

Highlights
* 2 rooms with open kitchen and comfortable bathroom
* Fully furnished with high-quality interior design
* Triple-glazed windows with electric exterior blinds
* Modern continuous laminate flooring with underfloor heating
* Open, fully equipped kitchen with induction cooktop, oven, dishwasher, kettle & toaster
* Towels, bed linen, household items and complete kitchen equipment included
* Washing machine with dryer function
* Iron, ironing board, cordless vacuum cleaner and hair dryer
* Height-adjustable workspace with monitor
* Smart home control center (tablet-based system)
* Smart TV & high-speed Wi-Fi
* Parking is readily available on the access street in front of the property.

The apartment is ideally suited for up to two persons.
(The double bed can be separated into two single beds 90 × 200 cm upon request.)

Ideal For
* Corporate employees & company apartments
* Project managers, consultants & executives
* Expats & international professionals
* Commuters with a second residence
* Temporary accommodation during construction, renovation or relocation phases

Transport Connections & Business Locations
* The Bremen-Oberneuland train station is only approx. 500 meters away. From there you can reach Bremen city center / main station in about 8 minutes.
* The BSAG bus lines 33 and 34 are within 5 minutes walking distance.

* Bremen city center: approx. 15 minutes
* Motorway A27 (Neue Vahr / Oberneuland exit): approx. 5 minutes
Bremer Kreuz interchange: approx. 6 km
(A1 Hamburg ↔ Osnabrück and A27 Bremerhaven/Cuxhaven ↔ Hannover)

The combination of nature, tranquility, and proximity to the city makes this location particularly attractive for demanding tenants.
